finding.text: Deliverable 2 is not done: placed content still waits for directory.json. `core/Page/Markdown.js:23` `child()` awaits `node()` → `tree()` (the listing) before drawing any placed .md, and `ai2/groups.js:203` `task_at()` returns nothing until `this.dir` is loaded. The diff only adds `priority: "low"` to the fetch; nothing is decoupled.

`priority: "low"` on a fetch that is still on the critical path can make the table appear *later*, not sooner. `Markdown.js:72` and `groups.js:118` now deprioritise the very request the table is waiting on. Draw the placed files first (e.g. try `Page.file()` straight away and fill the listing in afterwards), or drop the priority hint.

Deliverable 3 is missing. task.jsonl shows five edits and nothing after them: no Fast 3G or Wi-Fi-like measurement, no line posted to the card, no send_to_agent to task-mastermind-page-system. `Server/compress.js:16` also points to "the measured before/after" in this folder, and that file does not exist.

`Server/compress.js` looks right for `express.static`: it compresses before static, honours Accept-Encoding, uses zlib only and skips bodies under 1 KB. The dev server must be restarted before anyone sees the change (`Server/` changes need a restart), and a measurement taken without a restart would show no difference.
`compress.js:65` `res.end(chunk)` calls `res.write(chunk)` on any truthy value, so `res.end(callback)` would throw inside `Buffer.from(fn)`. Guard the call with `typeof chunk !== "function"`.

`compress.js` also compresses Range (206) responses and keeps static's ETag the same for compressed and plain bodies. That is harmless for dev json/js/md, but the cleanest fix is to skip the request when `req.headers.range` is set.
Compression alone probably fixes most of the owner's delay (3.3 MB of JSON gzips to a few hundred KB). Measuring after only item 1 would show whether item 2 is still worth the code.
